source: Existing full Pilot only; no inference changes the Pilot result.
sampling: One randomly selected repeat per randomly selected distinct case/state; case clusters retained for intervals.
judge_model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B revision b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218 (same model family as Pilot; exploratory LLM judge, not independent clinical adjudicator).
gold_and_rationale_usage: Added only after rollout for post-hoc annotation; neither was given to the Pilot Expert/Base calls.
label_method: Qwen3-8B post-hoc rubric labels, conditional on benchmark gold; outcome-based degradation is separately recomputed for all 873 paired CONSULT/ANSWER rollouts.
